notes.summary: Ranking questions give positions from the left/right or top/bottom, or compare people (taller, heavier). Use simple formulas and a quick line diagram.

concepts.title: Position formulas
concepts.body:
Total = (position from left) + (position from right) − 1.
Position from right = Total − (position from left) + 1.

concepts.title: Persons between two people
concepts.body: If both positions are counted from the same end, persons between = difference − 1.

concepts.title: Comparison ranking
concepts.body: Write the names on a line from greatest to smallest as you read each clue: D > A > B > C.

varieties.name: Position in a row
varieties.how: Use Total = L + R − 1, or convert both positions to the same end.

example.q: Ram is 15th from the left in a row of 40. Position from right?

varieties.name: Comparison
varieties.how: Arrange all persons on one line using every clue.

example.q: A is taller than B; B is taller than C. Who is shortest?

tips: Convert all positions to the same end before comparing.
For "interchange" questions, the new position belongs to the other person's old place.
traps: Do not forget the −1 (the person is counted from both ends).
"Heavier than only T" means exactly one person (T) is lighter.

questions.q: In a row of 40 students, Ram is 15th from the left end. What is his position from the right end?
In a class, Rohan is 12th from the top and 18th from the bottom. How many students are there in the class?
A is taller than B. C is shorter than B. D is taller than A. E is shorter than C. Who is in the middle when they are arranged by height?
questions.solution:
D > A (D taller than A), A > B, B > C, C > E.
Order: D > A > B > C > E.
B is in the middle.

questions.q: In a row, A is 10th from the left and B is 15th from the right. When they interchange their positions, A becomes 20th from the left. How many people are in the row?
questions.solution:
After interchange, A is at B's old place.
So B's old place is 20th from the left and 15th from the right.
Total = 20 + 15 − 1 = 34.

questions.q: In a row of 50 children, P is 18th from the left end and Q is 20th from the right end. How many children are there between P and Q?
questions.solution:
Q from the left = 50 − 20 + 1 = 31st.
P is 18th from the left.
Children between = 31 − 18 − 1 = 12.

questions.q: P, Q, R, S and T each have a different weight. Q is heavier than only T. P is heavier than R but lighter than S. Who is the heaviest?
questions.solution:
"Q is heavier than only T" → T is the lightest and Q is 4th.
The top three are P, R and S. S > P > R.
Order: S > P > R > Q > T. S is the heaviest.
